protocol.claim_boundary: frozen-fit descriptive association between heldout transport outcome and residual geometry; no channel causality, intervention, routing, adaptation, learning, or architectural claim
protocol.decision_rule: For each checkpoint and descriptor, report all seed-by-projection cells. A descriptor is nomination-eligible only if its predeclared direction separates pass from fail cells in at least three of four seeds. No descriptor is nominated if that criterion fails; associations remain descriptive even if it passes.
protocol.fitting_rule: Fit every channel transport map and residual relationship predictor only on paired base-order train32. Apply all such objects unchanged to paired heldout-order eval32. The saved base-order proper-orthogonal full-state tracker defines the projected residual-energy descriptor.
protocol.outcome_rule: Strict transport pass is the frozen tracking rule: heldout proper-orthogonal true-label R2 exceeds both matched conditional-shuffle and analytic latest-cue R2. It is not an independent observation from the tracking artifact.
